new_learnings.text: When breadth collapses to 0.15:1 with 0/3 major indices green, even strong sectors become trading-only pockets rather than investable swing entries; defaulting to cash is correct.
new_learnings.mechanism: Weak index participation and broad downside pressure reduce follow-through probability for fresh longs, so single-stock strength is less reliable.

new_learnings.text: Today's strongest-looking candidates mostly failed on extension rather than thesis quality, reinforcing that MA-distance limits are the practical anti-FOMO filter.
new_learnings.mechanism: In weak tape, extended names lose support fastest because buyers are already crowded and there is little incremental demand left.

new_learnings.text: Sector leadership is narrow today: 通信设备 is clearly leading, but the rest of the market is weak enough that sector strength does not override regime weakness.
new_learnings.mechanism: Narrow leadership without index confirmation often produces false breakouts and failed continuation setups.
